parsed.reason: Multiple critical failures: (1) assumes the event happened well ("Hope the 4pm session was amazing"); (2) uses emoji and exclamation marks (greeting/hype); (3) asks a second question beyond the initial check-in ("How did she do?"); (4) offers to do something next (book the next one); (5) includes invented specifics (4pm time, website link); (6) uses pronoun assumption about the child ("she do"); (7) adds padding with link after the question. A proper message would simply ask "How did the Ari swim meet go?" with pressure explicitly taken off, nothing more.
